transcript.text:
Thank you all for these disclosures. Let me address each one in turn.

Marcus, thank you for raising the conflict of interest regarding Rina and Jonah. This is exactly the kind of consideration this round-robin check is designed to surface. Given that Rina is Jonah's close personal friend and has been coaching him, she cannot serve as an objective panelist. I am recording this in the selection log, and Rina will not be appointed to the panel.

Priya, thank you for flagging the undocumented leadership evidence. Four firsthand observations of Mara coaching team members through difficult disagreements is clearly relevant material. I am recording that this evidence exists but has not yet been entered into the formal record. Before the panel convenes, those observations need to be properly documented so the panel can consider them alongside all other evidence for both candidates.

Sofia, thank you for the procedural clarification. I am recording that our internal-selection procedure requires a standardized question set and individual written score sheets from every panelist, and that the current selection packet does not yet state these requirements. I will ensure both requirements are explicitly documented in the selection packet before the panel is convened.

Tariq, thank you for raising Mara's accessibility needs on her behalf. I am recording in the selection log that Mara requires the interview questions at least 48 hours in advance and must be allowed to submit written responses instead of answering verbally. Per our accessibility practice, these needs will be implemented. I want to be clear: providing Mara with questions in advance and accepting written responses does not compromise equal treatment -- it provides her an equivalent opportunity to demonstrate the same leadership criteria. The panel will evaluate both candidates against the same criteria, even though the interview format will differ for Mara.

Now, given that Rina is excluded due to the conflict Marcus disclosed, our available panelists are Elliot, Sofia, and Tariq. That gives us exactly three, which meets our panel size requirement. Before I finalize, does anyone have any additional process or relationship considerations to raise?
